method: Viewed all 42 shipped cards in art/out/fighters/<id>/ by eye: per-skin sheets with the splash at 800 px (card size and above) beside its 3D reference (art/.cache/fighters/paint/<sid>_<kind>_3d.png), the portrait at 480 beside its 3D, and 128/64 px chips (LANCZOS down, nearest-neighbour up to view). Full-resolution face crops at 2-6x on every changed card and on every Hesmi, Marund and Ilsheta face; feet crops on Ervet Stillwater; hand and lantern crops on Tunlan. Each fix-round card compared with the file g1a reviewed (git show d492b25c3:<path>). Note: the 3D references for marund (base and Gorgewalk splash) and all Hesmi splashes predate the fix-round renders; those ship as 3D and were judged on the card. Re-ran card_qa.py on the 7 fighters and node tools/gen_store.ts --check.
